segments.motivation: To efficiently plan, execute, and monitor projects across their teams.
To coordinate team activities, assign tasks, and ensure alignment on shared goals.
To organize their personal workload, track task progress, and collaborate with colleagues.

tasks.purpose: to ensure timely completion and identify bottlenecks
to foster collaboration and shared understanding
for easy access and historical reference

benefits.claim: Provides a centralized platform for managing all work items and projects.
Improves team communication and coordination on shared initiatives.
Offers clear insights into project status and individual responsibilities.

frictions.claim: May have a learning curve for new users due to its extensive features.
Pricing structure might be perceived as a barrier for smaller teams or limited budgets.
Some users might find the wide array of features overwhelming for simpler task management needs.
